patterns.note: Full-bleed hero images dominate the top of interior pages, often with overlaid text, establishing a strong visual impact before content sections.
A single sans-serif font family is used consistently, with significant variations in size and weight to create a clear hierarchy, including very large, bold headings and large italicized quotes.
The palette is predominantly monochromatic, relying on shades of white, light gray, and dark gray/black for backgrounds and text, creating a clean and sophisticated aesthetic.
Content sections and individual blocks (images, text) reveal themselves with a subtle fade-up and slight vertical slide animation as they scroll into the viewport on interior pages.
Interior project pages feature a consistent structure: a full-bleed hero, a project details block, large feature images, image galleries, and prominent large-format quotes.

technique_notes: Uses GSAP ScrollTrigger to animate sections and content blocks into view with a subtle vertical slide and fade effect as they enter the viewport, enhancing content discovery.
The main navigation is initially transparent over hero sections, then transitions to a sticky header with a solid dark background as the user scrolls down the page.

Content is structured with generous vertical spacing and flexible grid layouts for image galleries and featured content, often pairing large imagery with text blocks that occupy a portion of the content width.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body text) with smaller, lighter body text and uppercase navigational labels; hero titles are very large (~5-6x body).
design_tokens.spacing: airy (generous vertical spacing between sections and content blocks, creating a sense of openness, especially on interior pages)

standout: The site's design is distinctive in its sophisticated integration of large-scale, high-quality architectural photography as primary content, seamlessly blended with minimalist typography and layout. The subtle scroll-triggered animations enhance the visual storytelling without distracting from the impressive imagery, creating an immersive and elegant browsing experience that prioritizes visual impact.
